contract: one MPEG-TS input (TS188 or M2TS192) of authored synthetic streams, preloaded and read forward only, for one selected program

candidate: the strict source view's events drive the FFmpeg-compatible view (compat::pes observers and DemuxClock) for the one elementary stream of the program; packets the demuxer emits for carriers the source view rejects come from the reference-trace recovery projection

reference: FFmpeg's mpegts demuxer through custom AVIO (32 KiB buffer, reads of at most 64 KiB) with NOPARSE and NOFILLIN, no stream discovery and no decoders; every packet of the selected program in demuxer order

each packet folds stream index, PID, PTS and DTS in 90 kHz units (absent as INT64_MIN), duration, position, flags, payload length and bytes, and every side-data element (type, size, bytes); program and stream metadata are not compared

a case passes only when both reach EOF and both folds equal the expected fold recorded from the reference worker on the pinned build; those expected folds also equal the folds of the archived reference observations of the same inputs

a candidate context outside the composed profile (no single-stream scope at EOF, unrouted transport, PSI, clock or entity transitions, rejected carriers without a recovery policy, invalid PES framing) ends the operation with its cause and fails the case; an operation that finishes without a packet fails as an empty observation

the recorded 272-request set is replayed as these cases: requests with the same inputs, packet size, program and declared descriptor namespace (--dvb) are one compat-view operation and share a case; requests for the strict source view, including its optional source-clock projection, replay as the compat-view operation on their inputs; corpus.json lists every request under its case

requests over two media entities (a second segment, optionally after a discontinuity) stay cases: the candidate refuses at the entity boundary and the reference has no single-input equivalent, so they fail
